subject.title: fix(cron): protect recreated reminders from stale active runs

question: Should the protected cron-state repair be accepted after its final merge-result refresh and required checks complete?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the submitted patch is narrowly scoped and has strong supplied validation.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, confirm the complete check set and replacement-after-removal regressions on the final head, then merge the focused repair.

options.title: Pause for ownership review
options.body: Hold the PR if cron owners want a different long-term active-run identity model before changing terminal-outcome ownership.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, confirm the complete check set and replacement-after-removal regressions on the final head, then merge the focused repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work established the affected cron operation boundaries and this follow-up is scoped to those same modules.
